turns.text: Make one image, aspect 16:9, from this exact description: Wide landscape photograph, approximately 3:2, viewed from an elevated overlook straight into a deep, snow-covered mountain valley. A massive, sheer granite cliff fills the upper-left third, its flat vertical face glowing golden orange, with long dark cracks, rusty streaks, and snow along its rounded summit and pale gray base. A shadowed triangular mountainside descends diagonally from the left edge toward the lower center. Across the right half, steep blue-gray granite walls rise into irregular snowy peaks, with a broad rounded summit near the upper right and a smaller squared pinnacle beside it. Lower, sunlit cream-colored ridges close the distant central valley. Dense dark evergreen forest covers the valley floor and lower slopes, every tree lightly edged with snow. Thin luminous cyan mist forms horizontal ribbons and pools among the trees, strongest across the bottom left and central distance. Several nearby conifers overlap the lower edge; a tall sparse trunk stands right of center, and fuller snowy branches crowd the bottom right. The upper third contains deep cobalt sky and broad, soft white clouds tinted pale peach. Low sunlight from the left creates warm cliff highlights against deep navy shadows. Crisp rock textures, fine tree detail, strongly saturated colors, high contrast, expansive landscape photography. No lettering.
